SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS female_hypertension_patients FROM conditions AS c JOIN patients AS p ON p.id = c.patient WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND c.description ILIKE '%essential hypertension%' LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wellness_procedure_count FROM procedures AS p JOIN encounters AS e ON p.encounter = e.id WHERE e.encounterclass = 'wellness' LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS patient_count FROM conditions AS c JOIN medications AS m ON c.patient = m.patient WHERE c.description ILIKE '%essential hypertension%' AND m.description ILIKE '%lisinopril 10 mg oral tablet%' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patients_without_allergies FROM patients AS p LEFT JOIN allergies AS a ON a.patient = p.id WHERE a.patient IS NULL LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG(i.base_cost) AS avg_base_cost FROM immunizations AS i JOIN patients AS p ON i.patient = p.id WHERE p.birthdate >= CAST('2000-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 100

WITH prediabetes_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient FROM conditions WHERE description ILIKE '%prediabetes%') SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE), p.birthdate)))) AS average_age_years FROM patients AS p JOIN prediabetes_patients AS pp ON p.id = pp.patient WHERE p.deathdate IS NULL LIMIT 100

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start) AS INT) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT patient) AS patient_count FROM encounters WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG((CAST(stop AS DATE) - CAST(start AS DATE))) AS avg_inpatient_duration_days FROM encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'inpatient' AND stop IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100
